actionResultText:
Your **Projectile Motion Explorer** is ready! 🚀

---

### How to use it:

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Angle slider** | Sets the launch angle (0°–90°). Watch the trajectory arc reshape live. |
| **Speed slider** | Controls initial launch speed (10–100 m/s). Higher = longer range. |
| **Gravity slider** | Adjusts gravitational acceleration (1–20 m/s²). Try Moon gravity (~1.6) vs. Earth (~9.8)! |
| **Launch 🚀** | Fires the projectile and animates it along the path. |

---

### Key physics to notice:
- **45°** always gives the **maximum range** (when speed & gravity are fixed) — try it!
- **Range** scales with $v_0^2$, so doubling speed **quadruples** the distance.
- The trajectory follows:
$$x = v_0 \cos\theta \cdot t, \quad y = v_0 \sin\theta \cdot t - \tfrac{1}{2}g t^2$$
- After launch, the stats bar shows **Range**, **Max Height**, and **Time of Flight** in real time.
